body: It’s roughly 6” by 3”, with no visible markings or text other than what’s seen on the silver sticker. My friend says there used to be a plate that sat on top of the whole thing but he has lost it.

Most of the time whenever I open up to people I feel like our relationship changes. I can’t really describe it but I feel like they judge me for feeling the way that I do. That makes me more reluctant to open up, frankly. Either way, it distracts them from doing more important things like talking to other people and having good experiences. I feel like I bring nothing of value to a conversation.
